name: Personal NOC, SOC & Life Incident Response
primaryAppTa: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).

dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
